name: Aginera Takeoff & Estimation API
description:
REST surface of the Aginera Developer Platform — structured construction quantities, routes and schedules.

The Aginera Developer Platform exposes the same capabilities through MCP (for agents, at https://mcp.aginera.ai) and this REST API (for backend integrations). Both call the same services, so results, permissions and billing are identical.

**Versioning.** This document describes `v1` (contract 1.0.0-rc.1, status **current**). Additive changes are non-breaking; breaking changes ship as a new path version with a 12-month overlap and `Deprecation`/`Sunset` headers.

**Authentication.** OAuth 2.0: backends use client credentials (token URL shown in your portal); agents and humans use authorization code + PKCE via https://auth.aginera.ai. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Long-running operations** return `202 Accepted` with a job resource; poll `GET` or register a webhook. **Errors** are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

Each operation carries `x-aginera-cut`: `core` (first release), `beta`, or `commercial` (later).
